title: Asymptotic behavior of large-amplitude solutions to the Boltzmann equation with soft interactions in $L^p_v L^\infty_x$ spaces
summary: In this paper, we study the global well-posedness of the Boltzmann equation within the $L_{v}^{p}L_{x}^{\infty}$ framework for soft potential models with angular cutoff in a periodic box $\mathbb{T}^3$. By using a time-involved weight function, inspired by the works of [Liu-Yang,2017], [Duan-Yang-Zhao,2013], [Ko-Lee-Park,2022], we overcome the absence of a spectral gap.
